verses.text: Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
lines: Hear, Yahweh, and answer me,
for I am poor and needy.

verses.text: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.
lines: Preserve my soul, for I am godly.
You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

verses.text: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.
lines: Be merciful to me, Lord,
for I call to you all day long.

verses.text: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
lines: Bring joy to the soul of your servant,
for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

verses.text: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
lines: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive,
abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

verses.text: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.
lines: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer.
Listen to the voice of my petitions.

verses.text: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.
lines: In the day of my trouble I will call on you,
for you will answer me.

verses.text: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.
lines: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord,
nor any deeds like your deeds.

verses.text: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
lines: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord.
They shall glorify your name.

verses.text: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.
lines: For you are great, and do wondrous things.
You are God alone.

verses.text: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
lines: Teach me your way, Yahweh.
I will walk in your truth.
Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

verses.text: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
lines: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart.
I will glorify your name forever more.

verses.text: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
lines: For your loving kindness is great toward me.
You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

verses.text: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.
lines: God, the proud have risen up against me.
A company of violent men have sought after my soul,
and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

verses.text: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
lines: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God,
slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

verses.text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
lines: Turn to me, and have mercy on me!
Give your strength to your servant.
Save the son of your servant.

verses.text: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me.
lines: Show me a sign of your goodness,
that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed,
because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me.
